title: Chapter 179: Attacking The Demon Clan Castle (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 179: Attacking The Demon Clan Castle (Part 3)

Under the continuous attack of the demon army, the Zerg puppies continued to reduce their numbers. Naga looked at Host No. 3 and said: "Our melee troops are ready. Shall I send some to support?"

"No, our army has been lost. We will replace it tomorrow!"

Wu Qing passed Host No. 3 and simply refused.

The Nagas and the Zerg fought together, and it was said that Naga was the commander-in-chief. In fact, Naga still listened to Wu Qing's opinions regarding the combat arrangements of the Zerg army.

Put all the Zerg puppies in their early 300,000 on the front line, and move those that cannot be placed to the sides to firmly protect the Naga army. This arrangement is what Wu Qing requested.

At first, Naga did not agree. The Naga were a proud and warlike race and did not need the protection of the Zerg. The Naga warriors were all powerful melee masters and they had to fight side by side with the Zerg puppies.

Wu Qing found many reasons to persuade Nagasawa, but in the end he used the reason that the Zerg had the ability to sacrifice on the battlefield to get Nagasama to compromise.

Wu Qing said to Nagaya through Host No. 3: "The Zerg's battlefield sacrifice ability can sacrifice the enemies killed by the Zerg to the Zerg master!"

"The souls of the sacrificed enemies, even the most fanatical believers, will be taken away by the Zerg master and will not be returned to the hands of the evil god and higher demons. This can truly weaken the power of the evil god's camp!"

"The Zerg can obtain the gifts of the Zerg Lord by making sacrifices. The more enemies are sacrificed, the more gifts the Zerg will receive!"

"This is a good thing that kills two birds with one stone. The Naga tribe must not compete with the Zerg tribe!"

Wu Qing said this, so Nagaya had no choice but to compromise. If she continued to be tough, she would be disrespecting the Zerg.

The Zerg army rushes to the front line, and the Naga tribe not only loses face, but is actually the biggest beneficiary. In this way, letting the Zerg army fight on the front line is a good thing that kills three birds with one stone.

Nagaya could only do such a thing shamelessly.

…

On the battlefield, the demon army continues to increase. Even with powerful long-range support, the pressure on the Zerg puppies is increasing.

At this time, nearly 700,000 troops from the Naga city and a large number of combat equipment and supplies arrived near the battlefield in an orderly manner.

"Use the fighting troops as the front line, and the rear combat troops enter the formation in an orderly manner!"

"Siege equipment is ready to support frontline operations!"

Nagaya issued a new order.

Nearly 700,000 troops formed different phalanxes and integrated into the huge phalanx in an orderly manner with the Zerg puppies and Naga elite warriors as the front line.

A large number of siege equipment have been assembled and debugged at their respective attack positions and are ready to launch attacks at any time.

"No. 3, if we want to launch a full-scale attack now, we won't care about your battlefield sacrifices!"

Nagaya spoke to Host No. 3 and quickly issued combat orders to various troops.

The various siege equipment operation teams that were the first to receive the attack order launched an attack on the large number of demon troops assembled under the demon castle.

It was also the first time that Wu Qing truly saw the power of siege equipment in this world!

Dozens of metal balls with a diameter of more than one meter were thrown out by a large trebuchet made of all metal. The metal balls quickly flew over the demon army and exploded violently!

Countless metal weapons were sprayed down at the demon army below, shooting down a large area of the demon army!

Dozens of metal balls with a diameter of more than one meter are like dozens of air-burst heavy artillery shells, killing the demon army in a large area!

The siege equipment that looked somewhat like a multiple rocket launcher fired dozens of thick and heavy crossbow arrows into the demon army at one time.

"Boom boom boom...!"

These thick crossbow arrows will also explode, causing damage to surrounding enemies.

Wu Qing saw this scene through Host No. 3, as if he had returned to a modern battlefield. He saw large artillery shells and multiple rocket launchers fired by trebuchets!

Nagaya seemed to be able to sense Wu Qing's curiosity about the Naga siege equipment through Host No. 3, and took the initiative to explain: "This is a siege equipment that our tribe spent a lot of money to purchase from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce!"

"It's all thanks to these goblin creations that our clan has been able to sustain itself until now. We definitely won't be able to survive a long-term battle with the demon clan just relying on our military strength!"

"However, these foreign objects consume a lot of money and are inconvenient to transport. They can only be used to defend and attack the city!"

"Just like this attack, a large number of luck beads and energy coins are gone. Even if there are enough luck beads and energy coins, you may not be able to buy ammunition for these weapons!"

"This kind of foreign object will not be used until the critical moment, if it can be used!"

"There is not much ammunition stored here. I took it all out this time, just to take down this demon castle in one battle!"

Wu Qing saw through Host No. 3 that there were only three or four of those giant metal artillery shells next to each large trebuchet. The multiple rocket launchers had more ammunition, enough to fire several rounds.

This little ammo reserve can only be used at critical moments. This is a bit like those Zerg explosive mosquitoes flying in the air, especially the ten three-star explosive mosquitoes. If you don't use them, they will be gone!

Thinking of the explosive mosquito, Wu Qing didn't think that this expensive siege equipment was easy to use. To use such a precious thing to attack the enemy, it would be better to give it to the Zerg with luck beads and let the Zerg use the explosive mosquito to blow it up!

Ordinary explosive mosquitoes are not as powerful as those big cannonballs, but you can test the power of the three-star explosive mosquitoes later and see who is stronger and who is weaker than the big cannonballs.

The demon army withstood a round of attacks by such expensive siege weapons, and the losses were indeed heavy. In addition to those who were directly killed, there were also a large number of wounded who fell on the battlefield and had lost their combat effectiveness.

With the demon race's strong physical fitness and recovery ability, an injury of this level would take a long time to recover.

The Zerg puppies have given up their positions on both sides and have all moved to the front line, lengthening the front line.

In this process, we have the support of more long-range attack units from the Naga army that have just joined the battle formation. Otherwise, if the Zerg puppies want to rush to the front line from both sides of the battle formation, they will have to face the devil. The tribal army blocked the attack.

The strength of the Naga tribe's early participation in the battle was no longer comparable to that of the Demon tribe's army. The Zerg puppies on both sides of the battle formation were also bearing the attack of the Demon tribe's army.

With strong support from the rear, the Zerg puppies pushed the combat front line back to a position flush with the first line of the combat phalanx.

The Zerg puppies gave up their position, and the Naga army took over. The strength of the Zerg puppies at this time was about 250,000.

Its own combat power is stronger than that of the enemy, and it has large and powerful long-range support. The Zerg puppies that have been defending do not suffer much losses.

About 250,000 Zerg puppies are all placed on the front line of the Naga army. It is likely that the Naga army will not be allowed to move forward until they are all killed.

This made many Naga troops who fought with Zerg puppies for the first time shout out their kindness and were extremely moved!

"Boom...boom...!"

Dozens of fireballs, several times larger than those fired by ordinary flame demons, flew into the Naga army from all over the demon castle, and a fierce explosion occurred!

Wu Qing saw through Host No. 3 that on some high platforms in the demon castle, there were some particularly red flame demons standing, and it was they who launched those powerful fireballs.

Those special flame demons stand on high places and can control large fireballs to attack at extremely long distances.

This is easier to use than siege weapons. No wonder the demons don't deploy siege weapons on the castle. It turns out there is such a powerful flame demon.

"This is a three-star flame demon. It is an ultra-long-range attack unit in the demon army. It is a very big threat!"

"If we want to hit them, we have to use siege weapons. They are very flexible, and the attack effects of siege weapons are also very limited!"

"No. 3, can you try out the effect of your flying unit?"

"If we can defeat these three-star flame demons, our losses this time can be reduced a lot!"

Nagaya said to Host No. 3.

Wu Qing saw through Host No. 3 that the three-star flame demons were definitely fierce. The color they fired was close to the fireballs of the dog demons, and the explosion power was greater than the fireballs of dozens of ordinary flame demons put together. big.

This is like the difference between a 60-caliber small mortar shell and a missile. When such a big fireball explodes, neither the Zerg puppies nor the Naga warriors can withstand it, causing heavy casualties!

The three-star flame demon's flame talent is stronger, and he can control the fireball to fly very far away. Now with the advantage of the castle, he can blow up almost wherever he wants!

The Naga tribe's conventional fighting method is to use siege weapons to bombard them, or send strong men to deal with them. This can suppress the three-star flame demon to a certain extent.

But it is still very difficult to destroy the three-star flame demons. After all, these are three-star demons that can dodge.

"No problem, I'll order Explosive Mosquito to give it a try!"

Wu Qing agreed readily.

As soon as he agreed, the Queen of Insects personally directed the Explosive Mosquitoes to swoop down from high altitude!

Since Nagaya said that these flame demons have three-star strength, the number of explosive mosquitoes cannot be too small, otherwise they will not be killed in the first explosion and the enemies behind them will be on guard.

These three-star flame demons are very smart. Each person occupies a platform on the castle. There are only some tall lemures around to protect them. This makes it easier to avoid attacks and minimize casualties.

At each position of the three-star flame demon, there are 10 explosive mosquitoes swooping down. Wu Qing counted and found that there were more than 500 explosive mosquitoes in the air!

No matter what kind of enemy they are, facing the attack method of Explosive Mosquito for the first time, they will be a little unable to react in time.

When the height dropped to a certain level, all the explosive mosquitoes turned on the acceleration mode at the same time. Their diving speed was more than twice as fast, like lightning, thundering in the air!

"Boom boom boom!"

"Boom!"

On various platforms high in the demon castle, suddenly, big explosions occurred at the same time!
